purpose: Teach: せっせと/おっちゃん/大方/易く/総じて/ひそか/カワイイ/凄まじい

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、せっせと勉強してんな
lines.en: Riku, you've been hitting the books pretty hard lately.
lines.style: Teasing but genuine praise. Light, observant tone—catching him in something good. Quick tempo, almost conspiratorial, like she's noticed something he didn't broadcast.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、商店街のおっちゃんと仲良くなったろ、桜
lines.en: You've gotten pretty friendly with that old guy from the shopping arcade, haven't you?
lines.style: Deflecting with a counter-question. Slightly sly—turning it back on her before she can press further. Dry delivery, one eyebrow lift in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、大方の問題は解けたな
lines.en: You've managed to solve most of these problems, actually.
lines.style: Factual observation wrapped in casual approval. Straightforward pace. No condescension—just noticing he's better at this than expected. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ノートを易く貸してくれてサンキューな、桜
lines.en: Thanks for letting me borrow your notes so easily, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude. Almost apologetic in cadence—the thank-you of someone not used to asking for help. Soft on the opening syllable, slight pause before her name, like he means it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、総じてセンスあるな
lines.en: You've got real talent across the board, you know.
lines.style: Direct, sincere underneath the delivery. Steady eye-contact level. She's not performing flattery—just stating fact. Slight weight on 'real,' like she's correcting an assumption he might have.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ひそかに俺の事気にかけてるだろ、桜
lines.en: You actually do care about what happens to me, don't you? Even if you don't say it.
lines.style: Wry observation that's half-joking, half-testing. Light tone but the question underneath is real. Slight pause after the question mark—giving her space to either confirm or deflect back.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のリュック、カワイイデザインだな
lines.en: That backpack of yours is actually pretty cute, by the way.
lines.style: Offhand comment masking something softer. Looks away slightly on delivery. The compliment slides in like she's not quite admitting she noticed. Almost defensive in its casualness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭の準備、凄まじい量だったな、桜
lines.en: That was a ridiculous amount of work you did for the culture festival prep.
lines.style: Warm observation ending in gentle closure. Reflective pace—remembering the effort. No fanfare, just acknowledgment. Voice settles at the end like he's laying something down he's been carrying.
